purpose: Pre-scoring frozen add-on crossed target/hint evaluation of already fixed v4 predictions; no inference, training, coefficient fit or model selection.
freeze_rule: No predictions or truth read before base prediction_freeze.json and full prediction_cohort SHA verification; also verify input manifest, fixed v4 source/protocol hashes. No modification of frozen v4 source/cohort. Add-on code/protocol freezes before first read of metrics.
scope: Same synthetic generator and fixed grid. Phase0 only a named calibration/descriptive partition, phasepi/2 held-phase description; this add-on fits nothing. All synthetic content, zero-cell and rectangular queries are unsupported natural training conditions; no independent natural-image generalization or observed-y deployment claim.

metric_definitions.gain: (MSEpoint-MSEhint)/signal_energy, with SAME true targetQ for every hint; raw MSE primary also retained
metric_definitions.identity: gain=-change_energy-alignment where error=point-target and d=hint-point; alignment=2mean(error*d)/signal_energy. Exact posthoc identity, not predictor.
metric_definitions.matched_best: Matched rawMSE <= min over four hints +1e-12; ties declared at absolute rawMSE tolerance1e-12; report exact difference/regret as well. Target-aware ranking is scoring oracle, not selection.
metric_definitions.within_band_signs: For every model/n/phase and fixed band, counts gain>.001, gain<-.001, and inactive retained; report matched hints separately from all crossed hints. No case dropping.
metric_definitions.equal_area: For true target horizontal/vertical and direction (1,0)/(0,1)/(1,1), contrast=MSE(hint vertical)-MSE(hint horizontal). Positive means horizontal hint scored better at SAME target. Aggregate contrasts by target,direction,model,n,phase; pairing directional (1,0) vs (0,1) retains same k/phase/target. Does not establish causal mechanism on natural tasks.

resource.deadline: Required --launch-record with fixed start/deadline and external timeout120s; no resume or extension

retention: New output root required; preserve incomplete outputs/failures. No repairs into frozen source/result roots.
stop: Descriptive crossed analysis only; no new parameter search, no matched training authorization, no novelty or deployment gate.
